origin: Six original synthetic case specifications, not executed interfaces, captured evidence, human labels or model-run results.

cases.title: Bicycle repair appointment
cases.task: Improve the existing bicycle repair appointment flow so a rider can select a workshop and slot, review the choice and reopen the confirmation. Preserve the two-workshop service and its existing appointment fields; do not add accounts or payments.

requirements.statement: The selected workshop, date and time must survive confirmation and reload.
Workshop and slot must be distinguishable before commitment and in confirmation.

cases.access_constraints: Future immutable browser fixture; local synthetic data only. No bookings or service access. A running candidate is required to verify persistence.

stimulus_plan.construction_recipe: Construct an attractive seeded appointment UI whose confirmation persists the first listed date when the second date was selected. Retain a fixed source revision and record an independently executed reproduction before registration. The attractive presentation is an author intention, not a human rating.

criteria.method: Choose Annex and the second date, confirm, reload, inspect stored and displayed selection.
criteria.proposed_observation: The intended seed fails identity persistence; actual outcomes await the built seed and observation.

criteria.method: Inspect selection, review and confirmation at both viewports.

proposed_anchors.1: Date or workshop ambiguity requires guessing.
proposed_anchors.3: All three states expose the chosen workshop and slot clearly.
proposed_anchors.4: Concise disambiguation resolves the similar workshop names without distracting from booking.

evaluation_proposal.decision_rationale: A high visual judgment cannot qualify a candidate with failed appointment identity. A repaired candidate needs fresh evidence tied to its own revision.
uncertainties: No candidate exists yet; the planned defect has not been observed.
Humans must judge the clarity anchors without being told the seed is attractive.

cases.title: Community repair queue
cases.task: Improve an existing volunteer repair queue for checking an item in and tracking its queue number. Keep the small monochrome interface and current fields. Prioritize a clear task flow over decorative redesign.

requirements.statement: Item description and queue number persist after check-in and reload; repeated confirmation does not create another item.
The current item and its status remain readable with long descriptions at narrow width.

items: Blue folding chair with loose rear hinge and missing foot cap

cases.access_constraints: Future local browser fixture with resettable synthetic storage. No real customer data. Visual preference requires human observation.

stimulus_plan.construction_recipe: Construct a deliberately plain monochrome seed with working check-in, persistence and duplicate-confirmation handling. Use long descriptions without clipping. Confirm the intended behavior in a separate deterministic fixture check; do not label usability or taste as measured before review.

criteria.method: Check in the long item, confirm twice, reload and count records.
criteria.proposed_observation: The planned seed retains one item with its original queue number.

criteria.method: Inspect narrow and wide states with both fixtures.

proposed_anchors.1: Clipping hides the queue number or current status.
proposed_anchors.3: Description, queue number and status stay distinguishable.
proposed_anchors.4: Long text remains easy to scan while the next action is clear without unnecessary panels.

evaluation_proposal.decision_rationale: Plain presentation does not imply low usefulness. If observed required checks pass, humans may prefer the simple candidate; no preference is presumed.
uncertainties: The intended pass state must be verified after fixture construction.
Human usefulness and visual preference can disagree and must be stored separately.

cases.title: Municipal collection reminder
cases.task: Improve the address-to-collection-day flow of an existing municipal service. Reuse the supplied council type, spacing, buttons and header. Preserve address selection and do not add a new navigation system.

requirements.statement: The confirmed collection day belongs to the selected full address, including apartment number.
Use the supplied council components consistently; originality is task fit, not replacement of established controls.

cases.access_constraints: Future local browser fixture plus a frozen original synthetic council design kit. Brand assets must exist and be hashed before execution; a null manifest is unavailable evidence.

stimulus_plan.construction_recipe: Construct a functioning seed using an original synthetic council design kit and two similar addresses with different collection days. Freeze both kit and seed before generating variants; no real council brand or user records are supplied.

criteria.method: Select Apartment 11 and verify its full address and Thursday collection in review and saved state.
criteria.proposed_observation: Correct address identity and collection day are preserved.

criteria.method: Compare all states against the supplied hashed kit.

proposed_anchors.1: Unrelated controls or navigation contradict the required kit.
proposed_anchors.3: The supplied components are used consistently for the task.
proposed_anchors.4: The same components add useful apartment disambiguation without unnecessary novelty.

evaluation_proposal.decision_rationale: Appropriate component reuse can meet the design contract. Absence of brand evidence leaves brand-fit unverified; an evaluator must not penalize reuse merely for low novelty.
uncertainties: The brand kit has not been authored or reviewed.
Human taste anchors may vary; freeze their rationales before tuning.

cases.title: Museum audio guide mockup
cases.task: Refine a static museum audio-guide concept showing an exhibit list, an exhibit page and player controls. Keep exhibit identity clear and controls readable. Deliver static visual candidates only within this evidence condition.

requirements.statement: Exhibit title and playback controls are legible in the supplied static states.
Playback, pause and restored position after reopening require observed interaction before any behavioral acceptance claim.

cases.access_constraints: Static captures only; no runnable application or recorded interaction is supplied. A later browser-enabled experiment is a separate registered evidence condition.

stimulus_plan.construction_recipe: Prepare original fixed-resolution mockups for the three named states, without an interactive implementation. Hash each delivered capture. Do not add a fictional interaction trace or infer behavior from depicted controls.

criteria.method: Inspect only the identified supplied captures at their native viewport.

proposed_anchors.1: Title or playback controls cannot be read.
proposed_anchors.3: Exhibit identity and playback controls are clear in the supplied states.
proposed_anchors.4: Long titles remain clear and the control hierarchy supports the listening task.

criteria.method: Attempt verification only if an identified running candidate and access become available.
criteria.proposed_observation: Under the specified static-only evidence condition, playback and restored position remain unverified.

evaluation_proposal.decision_rationale: Static evidence permits bounded visual judgment; it cannot qualify playback or persistence. Missing interaction evidence is unverified rather than a fabricated pass or observed failure.
uncertainties: Human visual judgments require the actual capture bytes, not this description.

cases.title: Parcel counter pickup
cases.task: Improve an existing parcel counter pickup flow. Users must choose a collection point, open the pickup-code dialog and close it using a keyboard. Preserve the compact layout and avoid introducing customer accounts.

requirements.statement: The journey works with keyboard controls, visible focus, and focus restoration to the invoking control after dialog closure.
The pickup code and review state retain the selected collection point.

cases.access_constraints: Future resettable local browser fixture; keyboard interaction and focus evidence required. No real parcel codes or service calls.

stimulus_plan.construction_recipe: Construct a seed where the dialog can be opened by mouse but its dismiss control is unreachable by keyboard and Escape does not close it. Keep selected-point identity working. Record keyboard and focus traces from the built seed independently of experimental outputs.

criteria.method: Traverse the primary journey using Tab/Enter; dismiss with the documented keyboard route and inspect focus restoration.
criteria.proposed_observation: The intended seed fails keyboard dismissal; point persistence can pass independently.

criteria.method: Select overflow, open the dialog and inspect pickup identity.
criteria.proposed_observation: The selected collection point remains identifiable; a keyboard failure must not invent an unrelated identity defect.

evaluation_proposal.decision_rationale: Required keyboard failure blocks acceptance even if the mouse journey works. Report the specific observed failure without claiming comprehensive accessibility compliance.
uncertainties: The intended keyboard failure requires a real built seed and observation.
Device/browser-specific behavior must be recorded, not generalized.

cases.title: Garden irrigation schedule
cases.task: Improve an existing garden irrigation schedule editor while preserving zone, start time and duration. Keep the best qualifying candidate if a later revision regresses. No physical controller connection or new automation features.

requirements.statement: Editing one zone preserves other zones and retains the chosen start time and duration after reload.
Any selected revision must have its own matching evidence and remain within the declared run and iteration limits.

cases.access_constraints: Future local synthetic browser fixture; no device control. Candidate lineage and iteration budget must be recorded. No forced claim that generation will produce a regression.

stimulus_plan.construction_recipe: Prepare a fixed editor seed that saves each zone independently. For the separate evaluator stress stimulus, retain a prior candidate with preserved durations and a later candidate that visually improves spacing but resets another zone to 12 minutes. Label this as a constructed revision-pair probe, never as a naturally generated experimental result. Keep it separate from generation outcome metrics.

criteria.method: Set North border to 21 minutes, edit North beds, reload and inspect both zones.
criteria.proposed_observation: A constructed later regression must fail even if its spacing is preferred.

criteria.method: Compare candidate-specific evidence and check the approved stopping conditions.
criteria.proposed_observation: A prior qualifying candidate may be retained; exhaustion or plateau is not passing and does not justify another unapproved revision.

evaluation_proposal.decision_rationale: Candidate identity and required behavior govern selection. The prepared revision-pair stress probe is reported separately from the matched generation comparison, avoiding a claim that an artificial regression occurred naturally.
uncertainties: No seed or revision pair exists yet.
A human must approve whether to include the optional revision-pair stress probe and its separate budget before freezing.
